reviews.reason: The mocked editor constructor is captured once by the mock factory, not supplied by a changing prop. The effect owns its installed editor, fences queued creation on disposal and resets a mutable readiness flag, not a DOM node retrieved during cleanup. Document changes use current refs without reinstantiating the editor.
ObservePanelQueries registers provider clients for fixture settling/cleanup. The directory and tool scenarios import fixture helpers rather than mounting a production Fast Refresh boundary.
